categories.main_business_segments: Launch Tech Company Limited operates primarily in three segments: automotive diagnosis, lift products, and overseas sales. The automotive diagnosis segment involves R&D, production, and sales of automotive diagnostic and inspection products. The lift segment focuses on R&D, production, and sales of machinery products for the automotive aftermarket. The overseas sales segment manages development and maintenance of distributors and customers mainly in Europe, America, Australia, and Asia.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes technical innovation and independent R&D, owning hundreds of patents globally. It develops automotive diagnostic, testing, maintenance, and tire equipment, including proprietary Internet of Vehicles chipsets and cloud diagnosis eco-chain technologies. Manufacturing of machine products is outsourced to high-quality external partners to reduce costs and improve efficiency. The company also develops software products with smart pricing algorithms and remote diagnostic platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Launch Tech serves automotive aftermarket customers including repair shops, vehicle maintenance and inspection centers, and end-users of automotive diagnostic equipment. It has millions of end-users and connects nearly 3.2 billion vehicles. The company also targets new energy vehicle maintenance workshops and government procurement projects. Its customers include distributors, dealers, and authorized training centers domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in the People's Republic of China with dozens of branches and offices and hundreds of dealers. Overseas, it has subsidiaries in the United States, Germany, and Italy, and over two hundred dealers across Europe, America, Australia, and Asia. It maintains global multi-regional operation centers to enhance customer service.
categories.supply_chain_position: Launch Tech operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the automotive aftermarket supply chain, focusing on R&D, production, sales, and service of automotive diagnostic and maintenance equipment and software. It outsources manufacturing of machine products to external partners, indicating a focus on product development and distribution rather than raw material sourcing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in automotive diagnostics and Internet of Vehicles technologies, investing approximately 15% of operating income in R&D. It focuses on smart operations including smart pricing, marketing, and customer systems, and expanding new energy vehicle diagnostic products. The company aims to strengthen overseas expansion, increase active terminal usage, and improve supply chain efficiency while maintaining a strong patent portfolio and technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Launch Tech generates revenue mainly through product sales of automotive diagnostic equipment, lift machinery, and software products. It also earns from software upgrades, remote diagnostic services, and licensing. The company benefits from government grants and investment income, including gains from disposal of subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leader in China's automotive diagnostic equipment industry and a pioneer in Internet of Vehicles technology globally. It competes on the basis of technological innovation, comprehensive hardware-software integration, and smart operational standards. Specific competitors are not named, but the company emphasizes its leading market position and extensive patent portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Launch Tech reported operating income of approximately RMB1,177 million, a 12.47% decrease from the previous year, but net profit surged by 255.06% to RMB328 million, mainly due to disposal gains from a subsidiary. The company has total assets of about RMB1.987 billion and equity of RMB1.072 billion, with a gearing ratio improved to 0.85. The software business and overseas sales showed resilience and growth despite global economic challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Launch Tech differentiates itself through its strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and leadership in automotive diagnostics and Internet of Vehicles technologies. Its products, such as the 'Electronic Eye' and 'X431' diagnostic tools, are industry benchmarks. The company offers unique remote diagnostic functions and smart cloud-based services, providing customers with advanced, efficient, and location-independent automotive maintenance solutions.
